Meta.Description: Investor-ready MVP for a digitally enabled healthcare operating network for East Africa. Integrates digital access, physical healthcare delivery, pharmacy, diagnostics, specialist networks, chronic-care management, and clinical knowledge within a single ecosystem.
Meta.Goal: Build the MVP to execute a 7-minute investor demo (Book -> Intake -> Video -> Rx -> Pharmacy -> Metrics).

ContractModel.OverseasSpecialists: Standard non-US Independent Contractor (IC) agreements and international wire transfers.

ThirdPartyIntegrations.Payments: M-Pesa Daraja API, Airtel Money API, Stripe (for IC payouts)

Communications.VideoAudio: Dual-mode architecture: Custom WebRTC (COTURN/STUN) AND Managed API (AWS Chime SDK or Twilio Video) abstracted behind a single interface.
Communications.Async: WebSockets / RESTful API for Store-and-Forward messaging.

TelecomGateway.USSD: Mock adapter for Direct Telecom APIs (Safaricom/MTN). No hard dependency on direct API keys for MVP demo.

Features.Feature: Routing to MHS-affiliated pharmacies (Africanna Health Center, The Clinician Clinic)

Accounts.Patient: Test Patient: "Jane Doe" (has allergies, insurance, medication history)
Accounts.Provider: Test Clinician: "Dr. John Mwangi" (has open calendar slot)
Accounts.Pharmacy: Test Pharmacy: Africanna Health Center - Westlands (mapped to patient address)

Data.SyntheticData: Ensure all data is clearly synthetic/test data, no real PHI.
Data.Formulary: Include 3-5 sample drugs. Include one that triggers an Allergy/Interaction alert.

Setup.Fallback: Pre-recorded screen-capture backup of the full flow, in case of live network failure.

Runbook.Step: Setup Line: State plainly this is a live product, not a mockup.
Booking + Intake: Patient logs a symptom, picks a same-day slot, completes quick intake.
Video Visit: Provider joins, brief scripted exchange takes place, provider writes a note.
Prescription: Provider e-prescribes; show the allergy/interaction check firing (demonstrating safety layer).
Pharmacy Handoff: Script auto-routes to nearest pharmacy; patient receives status update (Ready for Pickup).
Close: Cut to the Metrics Slide - transition into the pitch discussion.

MetricsDashboard.Purpose: Built to show real (or realistic) numbers immediately after the demo.

Metrics.Metric: Booking → Completed Visit → Prescription Issued → Filled (Conversion rates)
Average time from booking to seeing a provider; prescription to pharmacy pickup.
Cost per consult, revenue per consult, pharmacy margin share.
% of patients who return within 90 days.
Why video + pharmacy beats point solutions (full loop ownership).

EdgeCaseScript.Scenario: Provider tries to prescribe a drug the patient is allergic to; the system flashes a warning and blocks the prescription until overridden.

NonFunctionalRequirements.Requirement: No visible loading spinners during the investor demo. Audio latency < 300ms.
Total system resilience for the live demo; must not crash under stress.
End-to-end encryption. Strict GDPR/Kenyan DPA compliance.
Auto-scaling on AWS. Must handle 10,000 concurrent users.

Pass.Criteria: At least 70% of eligible consultations reach completion.
One viable paying or funded customer segment demonstrated.

Fail.Criteria: Pharmacy status does not update in real-time.
Network failure causes full demo crash without backup.
